definitions.explanation: A defined area of ocean or sea. Used in maritime, military, environmental, and news contexts to identify specific regions of the sea.

examples.japanese: この{海域|かいいき}は{危険|きけん}だ。
{台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{広|ひろ}い{海域|かいいき}が{荒|あ}れている。
examples.english: A wide area of the sea is rough due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{周辺|しゅうへん}の{海域|かいいき}では、{外国|がいこく}{船|せん}の{不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Illegal entry by foreign vessels has become a problem in the waters around Japan.

notes:
A compound of {海|かい} (sea) and {域|いき} (area, zone). More specific than {水域|すいいき}, which includes freshwater areas — {海域|かいいき} refers exclusively to ocean and sea areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周辺|しゅうへん}{海域|かいいき}: surrounding waters
- {排他的|はいたてき}{経済|けいざい}{水域|すいいき} (EEZ) に{含|ふく}まれる{海域|かいいき}: waters within the exclusive economic zone
- {危険|きけん}{海域|かいいき}: dangerous waters
- {海域|かいいき}を{封鎖|ふうさ}する: to block off a sea area
- {漁場|ぎょじょう}の{海域|かいいき}: fishing waters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水域|すいいき}: waters — broader term including rivers, lakes, and oceans
- {領海|りょうかい}: territorial waters — the sovereign sea zone extending from a nation's coast
- {公海|こうかい}: high seas, international waters — waters not under any nation's jurisdiction

cross_references.description: broader term for any body of water
